title: Set your face against daughters who prophesy from their heart
english: [[Set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own hearts >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:17]]. The soul has a face that must be braced against lying oracles.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Blotted from Israel’s writing
english: Lying prophetesses [[shall not be in the writing of the house of Israel >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:9]]; they are [[blotted from the book of the living >> Bible:Psalm 69:28]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
